preliminaryRun.note: This exploratory run overlapped npm ci in the same checkout. It passed 6/16 expected outcomes in each mode; the remaining commands exited 1. Raw stderr was not retained, so individual startup failures cannot be independently attributed. No case was removed. The complete observed record is retained here; isolated reruns follow.
